entries.description: Authored ai-assignment.md via route(task_type='analysis', complexity_hint=55)
Read ms-vbal-summary.md Section A, ms-vbal-coverage.csv lexical rows, hazard-list.md Section A, and fixtures 01/07.
Authored Vba.g4 lexical section in-conversation (Opus orchestrator matches route(architecture) target per Convention).

Switched AccessHarvester.Vba.Grammar.csproj from Antlr4.Runtime 4.6.6 (placeholder echo target) to Antlr4BuildTasks 12.8.0 + Antlr4.Runtime.Standard 4.13.1; resolves the parser-foundations deferred 'ANTLR4 Code Generation' item.

Authored 42 hermetic lexer unit tests under tests/AccessHarvester.Vba.Grammar.Tests/Lexical/VbaLexerTests.cs covering hazard-list Section A entries (H-A01..H-A09) plus Round-1/2/3 verifier-driven regressions.
dotnet build AccessHarvester.sln + dotnet test AccessHarvester.sln --no-build (sequential per project-guidance). 137 tests, 0 failures.
Round-1 session-verification via route(task_type='session-verification') to gpt-5-4. Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND (1 Critical, 4 Major).
Round-2 verification (complexity_hint=85) after applying R1 fixes. Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND (1 Major regression in REM_COMMENT bare-form predicate).

Round-3 verification (final retry) after applying R2 fix. Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND (1 Major: REM line-continuation leading-marker case). Fixed in-place per vba-spec-study Session 3 precedent; retry cap reached.
Read coverage matrix expression rows, hazard-list Sections B/C, fixtures 02/03/06.

Authored expression-grammar section of Vba.g4 in-conversation per Convention (Opus 4.7 orchestrator matches route(architecture) target). Added expressionEof, expression (left-recursive precedence), lExpression, primary, literal, typeName, argumentList, argument, namedArgument, typeOfExpr, newExpr, addressOfExpr, memberName, reservedKeywordName.

Authored 30+ test methods (66 instances after Theory expansion) under tests/AccessHarvester.Vba.Grammar.Tests/Expressions/VbaExpressionParserTests.cs covering primaries, member chains, calls, operator precedence, TypeOf, New, AddressOf, implicit-With, and corpus-witness expressions.

dotnet build + dotnet test sequentially. Build succeeded (0 errors). 107/108 grammar tests passed; 1 failure on `Forms!frm!ctl.Property` because PROPERTY is a reserved keyword lexer token. Fixed by adding reservedKeywordName rule to memberName.

Round-1 session-verification via route(task_type='session-verification', complexity_hint=70). Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND (1 Major, 1 Minor). Major: lExpression too broad for TypeOf/AddressOf operands. Minor: no negative tests.

Applied R1 fixes: added procedureReference rule (used by addressOfExpr) and referenceExpression rule (used by typeOfExpr). Updated AddressOf tests to access .procedureReference() instead of .lExpression(). Added 7 negative test instances for invalid TypeOf/AddressOf operands.
Round-2 verification (complexity_hint=85). Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND (1 Minor). Minor: bare `AddressOf Me` still parsed (Me alone is the instance, not a procedure pointer).

Applied R2 fix: split procedureReference into two alternatives - `(IDENTIFIER|TYPED_IDENTIFIER) (DOT memberName)*` and `ME (DOT memberName)+` - requiring at least one member after Me. Inlined procedureRefHead. Added `AddressOf Me` to the negative-test theory.
Round-3 verification (final retry, complexity_hint=70). Verdict: VERIFIED.
Final build + test sequentially. 0 build errors. AccessHarvester.Vba.Grammar.Tests: 117/117 passed. AccessHarvester.Tests: 127/127 passed. Total: 244/244 passed.
Routed analysis recommending Session 3 orchestrator. Saved to next-orchestrator-recommendation-session-3.md.
Read Session 3 spec; verified parser-foundations harness exists at tools/parser-harness/harness.py. Confirmed Session 2 commit at HEAD. API keys OK.

Added 'parse' subcommand to AccessHarvester.Cli/Program.cs with harness-contract JSON output (status/errors/tree_stats). Added bare-file fallback mode for harness compatibility. Added ProjectReference to AccessHarvester.Vba.Grammar in CLI csproj. Added BOM-aware + Windows-1252 source decoding. Updated PrintUsage().

Published CLI to tmp/parser-exe/. Ran parser-foundations harness against all 12 corpus fixtures. Result: 12/12 parsed, 0 errors, 0 ERROR_TOKEN characters across all fixtures. Baseline saved to tmp/harness-session3-baseline.json.

In-conversation schema-validation (Sonnet orchestrator matches routing target per Convention). Compared coverage-matrix expression rows (§5.1-5.2, §5.6) and lexical rows (§3.3-3.4) against grammar. PASSED: all in-scope 'must' rows covered. Statement-tier (§5.3-5.5) correctly deferred to #4.
Authored docs/spec-coverage/parse-failure-log.md with Session 3 baseline entry: harness results table, analysis, schema-validation correspondence table, open items for #4.
dotnet build + dotnet test sequentially. 0 errors. 117/117 grammar + 127/127 legacy = 244/244 pass.
Round-1 session-verification via route(task_type='session-verification', complexity_hint=70). Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND (4 Minor).

Fixed all 4 R1 Minor issues: (1) bare-file heuristic → known-command exclusion; (2) UTF-8-only decoding → BOM-aware + CP-1252 fallback; (3) schema table missing AddressOf/implicit-With/named-args/empty-args rows; (4) PrintUsage() missing parse documentation.
Round-2 verification (complexity_hint=70). Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND (1 Minor). Encoding.Default is locale-dependent; pinned to GetEncoding(1252).

Round-3 verification (retry cap reached). Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND (1 Minor persistent encoding). Fixed in-place: replaced BOM+try/catch approach with BOM-first / Windows-1252-default (no try/catch). Simpler and fully deterministic.
Final build + test after R3 fix. 0 errors. 244/244 pass.
Routed analysis recommending Session 4 orchestrator. Saved to next-orchestrator-recommendation-session-4.md.
